scope: Corollary 3.3 of the manuscript “Finite Instructions and Solenoidal Shear Flows” (preprints/Finite-Instructions-and-Solenoidal-Shear-Flows-September-27-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 376 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0cdc2abd5b1a3d15), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under Theorem 3.2, suppose a branch satisfies pi,1, qi,1 ≤ a. Every point starting in Pi × {z0} has first coordinate at most a + 2h throughout the period. If instead both centers are at least a, its first coordinate is at least a − 2h. If O ⊆ T3 L is open and Qi × {z0} ⊆ O, every point starting in Pi × {z0} reaches O at the integer sample and remains there for a time interval.
